camera: Video calls and sending photos need the camera.
microphone: Voice calls and voice notes need the microphone.
contacts: It finds which of your contacts already use the app.
photos_files: You need it to send pictures, videos and documents.
notifications: It alerts you to new messages.
location: Only needed if you share your live location.
sms: Some apps use it once to verify your phone number. It is rarely needed after setup.
bluetooth: Useful for calls through earbuds or a car.

location: It cannot give directions without knowing where you are.
background_location: Turn-by-turn directions keep running when the screen is off.
contacts: Saved places such as a friend's address.
overlay: Some apps show a floating map. Allow it only if you want that.

name: Flashlight, calculator or other simple tool
unusual: A simple tool has no reason to ask for this, which is a classic sign of an app collecting your data.

camera: Some flashlight apps use the camera's LED. A calculator or notes tool does not need it.
notifications: Only useful for reminders you set yourself.

camera: Taking and editing photos is the whole job.
photos_files: It opens and saves your pictures.
microphone: Needed only to record sound with videos.
location: Used to tag where a photo was taken. You can turn that off.
notifications: Updates on exports or shared albums.

name: Banking and payments
unusual: Banking apps are prime targets for fraud, so any unexpected permission deserves extra suspicion.

notifications: Alerts for transactions and security codes.
camera: Scanning cheques, QR codes and ID documents.
location: Fraud checks and finding nearby branches or ATMs.
contacts: Sending money to people in your contacts.
sms: Some apps read one-time codes. Typing the code yourself is safer.

camera: Taking photos and videos to post.
contacts: Finding friends. You can skip this and search by name instead.
location: Tagging places and finding nearby events.
calendar: Adding events you reply yes to.

name: Game
unusual: Most games do not need personal data. Free games that ask for it are often collecting it for advertising.

notifications: Reminders and rewards. Easy to switch off if they get pushy.

body_sensors: Reading heart rate and other sensor data is the point of the app.
location: Mapping the routes of your runs, walks and rides.
bluetooth: Connecting to watches and heart-rate straps.
background_location: Tracking a workout while the screen is off. Allow it only while a workout is running.
camera: Scanning food barcodes or taking progress photos.
photos_files: Saving progress photos or exporting your data.
